messages:
Maya (PM): ok team — planning sync for Hosted API Q3. main asks from customers: cheaper embeddings, lower rerank latency, clearer SLA for chat. want to align on scope and launch gates.
Omar (Eng): +1. embeddings cost is a recurring ask from 3 customers, also two small startups asked for per-embedding deduping cache.
Liam (ML): on rerank — we see tail p99 spikes when combined with long context. we can optimize scoring path but need kernel changes + perf testing. estimate 6 weeks.
Grace (ProdOps): customers require an SLO for rerank p95 < 120ms for 90% of traffic. is that achievable without dedicated pools?
Omar (Eng): short answer: not reliably on shared hosted. options: (A) introduce a low-latency tier (reserved workers) or (B) degrade model size for rerank. both have infra and pricing implications.
Maya (PM): decision needed: prioritize low-latency tier (higher price, faster time-to-market) OR model/quantization recommendations (cheaper, more work on quality). thoughts?
Liam (ML): quality regressions from quantization vary. for re-ranking small models work ok. we should run a quick eval: 5 corpora, measure NDCG drop. can do within 2 weeks.
Grace (ProdOps): pricing side: customers prefer a unit price drop for embeddings rather than a new tier. can we reduce unit cost by auto-batching + async ingest?
Omar (Eng): batching + async ingestion can cut cost ~20% for high-volume workloads. requires changes: client contract for async/ack, backpressure semantics, and retry guidance. ~3 sprint effort.
Maya (PM): proposal: split initiative into three deliverables: 1) Embedding cost reduction (autoscaling batcher + async ingest) 2) Rerank low-latency pilot (reserved pool for top customers) 3) Clear Hosted API SLA doc + rollout plan. prioritize (1) then (2) as pilot.
DevEx Bot: reminder — existing hosted API SDKs have breaking change risk if we alter ingestion semantics. schedule deprecation and migration docs.
Omar (Eng): noted. suggest we gate async ingest behind a feature flag and a beta program; DevEx to provide migration helper in SDKs.
Grace (ProdOps): beta gating + billing instrumentation required. add metering hooks for per-request time and token counts. ops runbook for fallbacks if reserved pool saturated.
Liam (ML): for rerank pilot we need synthetic workloads that mimic mixed chat+rerank traffic. I'll generate a corpus from anonymized customer traces. need privacy sign-off.
Maya (PM): action items: - Omar: prototype batcher + async ingest design doc by EOW (1752400000). - Liam: rerank eval + synthetic corpus in 2 weeks. - Grace: draft SLA language and beta criteria. - DevEx Bot: flagging migration steps.
Omar (Eng): quick note on metrics: track embeddings QPS, average batch size, successful async ops %, and end-to-end latency. may want a per-customer mode to opt into lower-cost async.
Grace (ProdOps): agreed. also include rollback plan: if async leads to customer-visible regressions, auto-disable per-tenant.
Maya (PM): launch criteria for embeddings cost reduction: >=15% unit cost reduction for top 3 workload patterns, stable error rate <= 0.5%, docs + SDK migration guides ready, and 2 pilot customers onboarded.
Liam (ML): rerank pilot launch criteria: p95 < 200ms for reserved pool, NDCG change <= 1.5% absolute, and two customer pilots.
Maya (PM): timeline check — Q3 goals: finish design + pilot in Q3, general availability by end of Q4. if infra runs into blockers we can decouple GA.
Omar (Eng): realistic: batcher + SDK work — mid-Q3 prototype, beta late Q3, GA early Q4. reserved pool for rerank — pilot late Q3.
Grace (ProdOps): I'll map out billing changes and update Contracts team for pricing language.
Maya (PM): cool. any blockers we should call out now?
Omar (Eng): kernel-level perf changes for rerank scoring could slip. suggest we start with thin-worker pilot (smaller model instances) while ML evaluates quantization.
Liam (ML): agree. also we should add automated regen tests for rerank to catch regressions during rollout.
Grace (ProdOps): note: compliance customers may require on-prem variant; we should define parity expectations for Private deployments later.
Maya (PM): ok thanks. I'll create the roadmap ticket and link dev/design docs. follow-up async: add any objections here or ping me. :thumbsup:
Omar (Eng): added a quick proto link in thread: https://redwood.internal/issue/PR-985
DevEx Bot: CI build for SDK migration helper queued (#ci-342).
